ko: 그의 빛으로 나아갈때 그 성품 닮아가네
en: I long to become like the Lord’s goodness and faithfulness
As I walk into His light, I grow to be like His character
As I become like the light, in the freedom the Lord has given Turning back to what is right, I shine like the stars
He shines His light on me, and darkness is revealed He sets me free from the hidden sins within me

ko: 빛 되신 우리 주와 그 생명 길 가네
en: By His light I rise up, and darkness is made clear With our Lord, the Light of the world, I walk the path of life
O my soul, arise and shine the Lord’s light For the glory of the Lord has risen upon us
